 ORDER
This is third bail application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

T he applicant has been arrested relating to FIR/ Crime No.466/2022, registered at Police Station Tendukheda District Narsinghpur (M.P) for the offence punishable under Sections 304-B, 498A read with section 34 of IPC and section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in custody since 23.11.2022.

First bail application (M.Cr.C No. 5525 of 2023) was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 06.02.2023 and second bail application (M.Cr.C No. 11531 of 2023) was also dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the same after recording the statement of material witnesses.

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, the allegation against the present applicant, who is husband of deceased Shivani.
Shivani died within one year of her marriage after consuming poison..

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that statement of Komal Pal (PW-1) father of deceased has been recorded on 09.06.2023 and Rekha Pal (PW-2) mother of deceased has been recorded on 16.06.2023 before the trial court.
Both these witnesses have made general allegation against the accused persons.
Applicant is in custody since 23.11.2022.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection and submitted that there are total 19 prosecution witnesses in the case and brother of deceased and other material prosecution witnesses are yet to be examined in this case.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and on a perusal of the material available on record against the applicant, this bail application is rejected.
Certified Copy, as per rules.
The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE tarun Raja Pali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190680573/
